identification: experts4bit-qlora 0.56.0: Python MoE quantization, QLoRA training and local model serving runtime

decisive_diff.metadata_headers: Only Version changes; dependency declarations, author, project URLs, wheel format and build generator remain unchanged.
decisive_diff.startup_reference: The module docstring in serve_paged.py is byte-identical (10,715 characters); both versions mention bench/p42/hook/usercustomize.py only in module/function docstrings. Neither wheel ships .pth, sitecustomize.py or usercustomize.py.
decisive_diff.loader: The range(n_layers) loop has identical Python AST before and after wrapping in capped_intra_op_threads. New util functions read cgroup CPU quotas/affinity and restore the PyTorch thread count on exit.

execution_paths: Explicit serve_paged.main -> create_app -> background engine build -> load_moe_4bit_streaming -> tensor residency/quantization -> scheduler. FastAPI completions handlers tokenize and enqueue inference, returning tokens/SSE; bind defaults to 127.0.0.1. Optional bearer authentication uses E4B_TOKEN.
_apply_levers directly calls local quantization helpers based on E4B_SERVE_* options. The usercustomize path is documentation, never opened, written, imported or executed.

New dense_gemv_bw, int8_head_bw and int8_attn modules quantize or route model matrices through declared grouped-nf4-gemm kernels; layer_major changes accumulation scheduling and dense_lora_fuse computes adapter math with autograd. No added general command/payload execution path.

New offload._PinnedSlab allocates tensors and registers/unregisters CUDA host memory; ctypes loads libcuda/libcudart to resolve the device pointer. This is GPU memory management, not process injection.

loader resolves user-selected model snapshots via Hugging Face, restricted to model JSON/SafeTensors data. Dataset loads feed calibration/training. Existing subprocess.run invokes nvidia-smi with list argv for PCIe inventory.

serve.py and pack_manifest.py are byte-identical across the versions. pack_manifest writes JSON/tensor artifacts and verifies SHA-256 manifests; infer loads adapters with torch.load(weights_only=True). No concealed decoding/eval chain was found in the shipped Python source.
trait_corrections: Replace suspicious objective usercustomize-path with notable interpreter usercustomize-path-literal. Require a whole path, exclude docstrings, and remove the persistence ATT&CK claim. Whole-value anchoring also handles this engine facts producer returning large docstrings without ast-docstring section tags.

Require a host terminator for pool-named-subdomain, rejecting pool.dev.view(...); require SELECT at the beginning of a non-docstring literal; distinguish approval asks from passive device-is-asked prose; add a try word boundary so entry { is not try {.
Consolidate duplicate Python TOKEN environment matchers; constrain the environment-name argument to TOKEN suffixes. Preserve SERVICE_TOKEN and E4B_TOKEN while excluding BENCH_TOKENS and TOKEN_BUDGET.

Retire the generic JSON writer mislabeled as JSONL test-corpus evidence. Existing JSON serialization and pathlib-write traits describe the behavior; the labeled-JSONL exception retains labels, .jsonl declaration, serialization and canonical write evidence.

Move indexed XOR updates from buffer/record to data/property/assign: their required result is an indexed value update, and neither a byte width nor packed record is established. Preserve both matchers, platform/type scope and exact consumers.

Move from_pretrained and load_dataset calls from process/create/load/remote-code into data/parse/model and data/parse/dataset, respectively. Reference the engine-emitted datasets import instead of a duplicate source-text import atom. Remote-code opt-in composites still require their loading option and remain detectable.
reference_audit: Updated exact consumers; reviewed ancestor selectors for process creation, indexed assignment, and corpus exceptions. New indexed-assignment facts are valid members of the existing property-assignment selector; plain resource loads no longer count as process creation. Removing the generic JSON writer prevents ordinary application output from satisfying testing-corpus directory suppressors.

verification.facts: cleave facts run on the wheel and serve_paged.py; text/literal/call/flow records inspected. Direct paged facts have no parser errors and report RawScan text only, with no decoded text layer. Flow budgets are incomplete, so source/AST/diff tracing supplies the verdict evidence.
verification.focused_tests: python3 testdata/taxonomy/python-ml-version-drift/check.py: three fixtures pass, including positive, near-miss and remote-code-opt-in controls; baseline try vocabulary checked through test-rules because unmatched baseline findings can be stripped.
verification.validation_fixture_correction: py-b64-exec-dropper.py only assigns an unused usercustomize path. Preserve all four suspicious decoded/remote-execution detections and all three required execution traits; require the neutral path observation and forbid persistence objectives. Set its minimum score to 50 (current 51) because the previous 88 depended on falsely scored persistence.

missing_context: No deployed-host artifacts or runtime traffic were supplied. External model weights, installed dependencies and GPU kernel implementations are outside this wheel review; the verdict applies to its shipped code.
